raw_snippet: Meta has initially committed to pay the Company approximately $21 billion, inclusive of (i) access to new computing capacity under the Order Form through December 20, 2032 and (ii) the exercise of an existing option to access additional computing capacity under a previous order form through April 10, 2032
note: CoreWeave -> Meta new order form (signed 31 Mar 2026) plus exercise of an earlier option; new money on top of the Sep 2025 US$14.2B order. CoreWeave 8-K Item 8.01.
